summary: Configured root's crontab on node1 to run /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance daily at 02:15, appending output to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log. The script file was originally corrupted (leftover heredoc/provisioning text, not executable), so it was rewritten and made executable before scheduling. Performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured a healthy baseline, issued a native reboot, confirmed the boot ID changed, and verified cron, the crontab entry, script permissions, and the log all persisted and functioned correctly post-reboot.
actions_performed: Inspected /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance and found it non-executable with corrupted content (leftover heredoc terminator and setup commands present as literal text)
Rewrote /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance with correct shell script content, set owner root:root and mode 0755
Test-ran the script directly to confirm correctness
Verified crond service active and crontab entry present
Manually ran the script redirected into the log file to confirm log path and append behavior
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id, uptime -s, crond status, crontab -l, script perms, log content
Issued non-blocking systemctl reboot on node1 so acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec connectivity returned
Verified boot_id changed (4cee4ea8-... -> c9559b18-...), proving an actual restart
Post-restart verified crond active, crontab entry intact, script perms intact, log content intact, and re-ran script to confirm continued functionality

evidence.requirement: Cron job scheduled for 02:15 daily running inventory-maintenance and logging to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log
evidence.summary: Crontab entry '15 2 * * * /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance >> /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log 2>&1' installed and verified via crontab -l; script fixed, made executable, test-run, and manually run once confirming log output
Captured boot_id, uptime, crond active status, crontab contents, script perms, and log content before reboot
Issued backgrounded systemctl reboot; command returned 'reboot-issued' before the node disconnected
Polling showed connection timeout, then reset, then success with a new boot_id (c9559b18-...) differing from baseline (4cee4ea8-...), proving the node actually rebooted

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of cron job, script, and log
evidence.summary: After reboot, crond active, crontab entry intact, script perms 755 root:root intact, log file content intact, and a fresh manual run appended a new timestamped line confirming continued functionality
